acquisition.rate_limit_policy: Stop scheduling on 429/403, Retry-After, hash mismatch or unexpected failure. Drain at most two in-flight bounded requests; preserve all remaining document slots as not_attempted. No replacement.

downstream.control: Authenticate #40 C2 controls and replay all three no-LM fits; require tensor equality. Reset RNG/optimizer before paired downstream adaptation.
downstream.model_selection: All six final checkpoints sealed before any new evaluation inference. Training process never opens evaluation arrays.

evaluation.contrasts: On source-isolated eligible pool, group by original-lemma basis, reading and coarse POS. At most 32 lemma/surface types per group. Deterministically select two different lemma/surface types, two examples each, with four distinct documents and bounded left contexts, per context_contrasts.py. At most 100 groups/400 rows. No converter/model outcome participates in selection.
evaluation.eligibility: Original morphemes only, reading 2..32 kana/long-vowel characters, surface 1..32 containing a CJK unified ideograph, preceding source context 8..64 characters within the same annotation unit. Exclude annotated alternatives and named entities. Preserve all exclusion counts and original annotations; no guessed readings or normalization.
evaluation.gate: Existing margin >1.7 unchanged; no calibration on this cohort.
evaluation.history: All #40 history plus every #40 source unit and eligible input, including excluded/unselected rows. Full source coverage for new cohort; same transitive source/near/input isolation.
evaluation.main: One target per document, bottom SHA256 [20261105,'language-main',stable_id]; all 1000 slots retained as terminal states.
evaluation.metrics: All seeds, raw/gated R/H/W, correction failures, precision/recall, application, candidate/ranking failures, component paired 95% intervals; never omit failures.
evaluation.primary: LM-on minus LM-off intact/ungated main per seed; all three paired 95% lower bounds >0, all point differences >=0 with positive mean, and supported contrasts improve in >=2 seeds to advance. Otherwise do not adopt. No best-seed or post-hoc budget search.
evaluation.runtime: CPU PyTorch FP32, one host thread; CPU ORT parity/latency for seed20260814; no GPU scores used to choose winners.

pretraining.architecture: Unchanged C2 character hash vocabulary, embedding and single-layer GRU. Tied embedding output matrix predicts one next-character hash class; PAD class excluded. Only embedding/encoder updated; ranking scorer stays unchanged during LM. No added inference parameters or vocabulary change.
pretraining.hypothesis: Learning next-character prediction from train-only source fragments improves candidate rescue with unchanged C2 ranking architecture and downstream supervision.
pretraining.isolation: Recheck train fragments against six original source generations, frozen inputs, every growth evaluation source (including excluded rows), all 1300 old KWDLC documents and all 1000 reserved new documents. Quarantine whole connected components. Previously approved growth train targets are allowed, not mislabeled as evaluation history.
pretraining.selection: Fixed final step only, no validation tuning. Record loss but never use it as adoption evidence.
pretraining.source_licenses: Reuse pinned v1/v2 Wikipedia/Aozora source, license and acquisition manifests. KWDLC never used for training.
pretraining.source_scope: Only population=train Wikipedia/Aozora original left_context+target fragments from authenticated v2 source isolation. No reading label used by LM; not a full-article/general-language corpus.
pretraining.windows: At most six positions per unique literal fragment, bottom SHA256 [20261105,'lm-position',text_sha256,position], positions >=8. Each uses only previous <=64 characters to predict the next character. Deduplicate exact (context,next-char) pairs, preserve provenance, choose lowest window hashes up to 500000 per corpus/1000000 total; no replacement from eval.

selection_rule: Bottom SHA256 canonical [20261105,'issue-41-language-pretraining-v1',document_id], exclude all 1300 exposed public-train documents. No public dev/test access or replacements.
source_rights_scope: Research feasibility/evaluation only. No model training or redistribution from KWDLC. Provider's original-author permission and source-URL limitations remain unresolved.

verify_expect.Verify: Source/license/hash and full history closure before LM

verify_expect.Expect: Only pretraining presence changes, no right-context/label use in LM
verify_expect.Verify: Causal windows, tied-head gradient and scorer freeze tests; identical downstream controls

verify_expect.Expect: No omitted seeds/failures or numerical tolerance changes
verify_expect.Verify: All model/score bindings, independent count replay, CPU parity and 10000 runs

verify_expect.Expect: No original data/model changes; Gold and .25% limits preserved
verify_expect.Verify: Full tests, historical artifact hashes and process/temp cleanup
